s.how: Fry 12 frozen donut rings or balls of 500g pizza dough at 175C until golden. Toss while hot in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon.
Beat 200g butter and 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 300g flour and chill. Roll, cut and bake at 170C for 12 minutes, then ice.

m.how: Roast a 1.5kg turkey breast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Boil 800g potatoes and mash with butter. Make gravy from the pan juices and powder.

w.how: Steam and mash 500g pumpkin. Beat with 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk and cinnamon. Pour into a pastry case and bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

d.how: Heat 1.2L apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks for 15 minutes without boiling. Ladle into mugs. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
